sources.label: Wikipedia, "Iota Hydrae"
sources.quote: Iota Hydrae, formally named Ukdah, is a star in the constellation of Hydra, about 8° to the north-northwest of Alphard and just to the south of the celestial equator.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 271 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,310 K, so 29.544 solar radii.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "Iota Hydrae"
sources.quote: Visible to the naked eye, it is a suspected variable star with an apparent visual magnitude that ranges between 3.87 and 3.91.
